zh.title: 复合误差与检查点
zh.question: 每一步都有 95% 做对，二十步的整条链一次无错的概率还剩多少？
zh.assumption: 只演示独立、必需步骤的概率连乘；检查点模式另假设无误报、精确回滚、每段至多一次独立重试。不是任何系统或模型的实测成功率；期望尝试次数把所有分段都排程计入，不是出错即停的运行成本。
zh.observe: 观察：把单步成功率或步数调成你的真实链路，端到端结果掉到哪里？检查点召回率要多高才兜得住？
zh.footerNote: 示意计算 · 模型假设 · 对应来源

resultLabels.segment: 单段成功率（一次重试后）
resultLabels.attempts: 期望段尝试次数（全部分段都排程）

curveLabels.alt: 曲线：单步成功率固定时，全程无错率随必需步数增加而下降；当前点的精确值见读数。

checkpoint.summary: 检查点模式（可选展开）：分段 + 每段一次重试
checkpoint.note: 期望段尝试次数是计划口径：假设所有分段都排程执行，不是出错即停的实际运行成本，也不是生产成功率。假设同时成立：步间独立、检查点无误报、回滚精确、每段至多一次独立重试。

explanations.steep: 结果不足 50%：在上述假设内，这条链路的多数运行不会全程无错。
explanations.moderate: 结果在 50% 到 90% 之间：在上述假设内，全程无错与出错的运行都不少。
explanations.mild: 结果达到 90% 以上：在上述假设内，这条链路的多数运行会全程无错。

en.title: Compounding error and checkpoints
en.question: If every step is 95% likely to be right, how much of a twenty-step chain survives end to end?
en.assumption: Shows probability multiplication for independent, mandatory steps only; the checkpoint mode additionally assumes no false positives, exact rollback and at most one independent retry per segment. Never a measured success rate for any system or model; expected attempts schedule ALL segments — they are not fail-fast runtime cost.
en.observe: Observe: move the per-step rate or the step count to your real chain — where does the end-to-end result land? How high must checkpoint recall be to hold it?

curveLabels.alt: Curve: with a fixed per-step success rate, the clean-run rate falls as required steps grow; the exact current value is in the readout.

checkpoint.summary: Checkpoint mode (optional): segments + one retry each
checkpoint.note: Expected segment attempts are a planning figure: they schedule every segment and are neither fail-fast runtime cost nor a production success rate. Assumptions hold simultaneously: independent steps, no false positives, exact rollback, at most one independent retry per segment.

explanations.steep: The result is below 50%: under the assumptions above, most runs of this chain would not stay clean.
explanations.moderate: The result is between 50% and 90%: under the assumptions above, clean and failed runs are both common.
explanations.mild: The result is at least 90%: under the assumptions above, most runs of this chain stay clean.
